posts.title: Meow-mazing or Meow-mazing Interactive? Two Gabby's Dollhouse houses, one name
posts.caption:
Two different Gabby's Dollhouse houses are sold as "Meow-mazing". The one with printed eyes takes no batteries and was about $25 at Walmart in our November 27 check (about $50 before). The Interactive one has screen eyes, sounds and games, takes 3 AA batteries, had a $107.99 list price in 2025 (The Toy Insider), and on November 27 Walmart had it only from a marketplace seller, so we give no typical price. Spin Master support says Deluxe Rooms sit inside the Interactive house but don't clip on; for the printed-eyes house we could not confirm it. The Interactive Ears headband and Interactive Pandy Paws plush link up with the Interactive house only. Go by the full name and the eyes, not the model number.

All four houses compared, every source dated: https://everylittleroom.com/guides/which-gabbys-dollhouse-to-buy?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=long

We have not tested these houses ourselves; facts are from the maker's and the stores' listings. Independent parents' site, not affiliated with the show or its makers. Synthetic voice. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

posts.title: Doozie's pack or the Gabby 6-pack for Christmas? About $20 each, one hard to find
posts.caption:
The Gabby & Doozie Sister Fun Pack (Gabby, Pandy Paws, Cakey Cat, Doozie, Puggie Paws, Creampup) and the Fairylandia Fairy-riffic Friends 6-pack are both about $20 at Walmart in our November 27 check. The Doozie pack was out of stock at Walmart on November 23, and Amazon search results showed it as currently unavailable on November 23 and 24. Walmart's listings say both packs go with the Meow-mazing Dollhouse. The Puggie Paws plush (about $15) is a pre-order, due in December, and our two sources disagree on the day; the LEGO set 11227 (about $20) is listed for January 1, 2027.

Every Doozie's Doghouse toy, store by store, with the dates we checked: https://everylittleroom.com/guides/doozies-doghouse-toys?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=long

Independent parents' site, not affiliated with the show or its makers. Prices are typical US store prices from our dated checks, never Amazon's. Synthetic voice. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
posts.script: Doozie's figure pack, or a Gabby six pack, for Christmas? Both boxes hold six figures, and both cost about the same. One of them has been hard to find. Six figures: Gabby, Pandy Paws and Cakey Cat, with Doozie, Puggie Paws and Creampup. / The Fairylandia Fairy-riffic Friends six pack is about twenty too, at Walmart in our November twenty seventh check. It has Gabby and five other figures, but the listings we read name only Gabby. / Both are listed for ages three and up. / Walmart showed the Doozie pack out of stock on November twenty third. / Target lists it, but its page shows stock only for a store you choose. / Amazon lists it too. Its search results showed it as currently unavailable on November twenty third and twenty fourth, with no restock date. Check there before you count on it. / Walmart's listing says the Sister Fun Pack plays on its own or with the Meow-mazing Dollhouse. / And the Fairy-riffic Friends can go into the Meow-mazing Dollhouse too, and are scaled for the Flutter Magic Fairy Playset, by Walmart's listing. / Doozie's Puggie Paws plush, eleven inches tall, is about fifteen dollars at Walmart, as a pre-order. / The LEGO set, eleven two two seven, has a hundred and thirty three pieces and is about twenty at LEGO. LEGO lists it for January first, 2027, so it is a gift for after Christmas, unless a store shows you an earlier date. / Is there a Doozie doghouse playset, like the Gabby dollhouse?
